name: Desk air-quality monitor
description: CO2, temperature and humidity on a small display, on your desk where you will actually look at it. The BME280 alone cannot measure CO2 — that needs an SCD41 — which is the point of listing them separately rather than hand-waving at 'a sensor'.

requires.note: host with wifi, to publish readings
true CO2, not an estimate from VOC

related_designs: OpenCircuitCore boards/sensor-breakout — the I2C sensor half of this, already ERC and DRC clean
